sources.title: cyttic/hmt-htrvt-elastic1-s42 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model htrvt, augmentation elastic1, seed 42. Trained on cyttic/hhd-optionb-split train minus the dev writers; HHD Option-B test, greedy decoding, no LM: CER 0.0622, WER 0.2819.

sources.title: GitHub - cyttic/htr-metrics-transfer
sources.snippet: Can training-free distribution metrics predict how much data augmentation helps a handwriting recognizer trained on a small real dataset? Real data only: HHD, Option-B split (cyttic/hhd-optionb-split, paragraph- and writer-disjoint). Greedy CTC decoding, no language model. Results go to Hugging Face (public); this repo holds code only.
